r: Statutory body under the **Competition Act, 2002**, as amended by the **Competition (Amendment) Act, 2007**
The Act **replaced the MRTP Act, 1969** and its **MRTP Commission** – shift from curbing monopolies to **promoting competition**
Notified **14 October 2003**; legal challenges delayed it; **fully constituted / functional in March 2009**
**Ensure fair competition in markets**, prevent practices with adverse effect on competition, protect consumers
**Chairperson + 2 to 6 other members**, appointed by the **Central Government** (original 2002 Act: up to 10)
e.g. **WhatsApp 2021 privacy policy** – Meta fined **₹213.14 crore**
Mergers and acquisitions; **₹2,000 crore deal-value threshold** for start-up "**killer acquisitions**"
CCI's **Digital Markets Division**; proposed **Digital Competition Bill** for **Systemically Significant Digital Enterprises**
Many sellers of differentiated brands (e.g. **toothpaste**) = **monopolistic competition**; identical product = perfect competition
**Telecom Regulatory Authority of India**; set up **20 February 1997** under the **TRAI Act, 1997**
**TRAI MyCall** revamped for call-quality rating (Aug **2026**), after **DND** and **MySpeed**
